prereg_note: Hypotheses, analysis plan, block definition, and decision rules are specified here before any results are computed. The eval script computes results against this pre-specified plan; no post-hoc changes.
rationale: No materially-different free external source with live/unfrozen coverage passed the source registry sweep (NO_NEW_ADMISSIBLE_SOURCE). Per AGENT_HANDOFF.md section 1 item 3, idling is forbidden; a new confirmatory design is registered on the admissible local data domain (research_state/data/raw/ BTC/ETH hourly klines + fundingRate, Jan-Mar 2024).
data_domain: research_state/data/raw/ (local raw CSVs, no network, stdlib-readable)
data_availability: BTCUSDT kline 2024-01-01 + 2024-01-02; ETHUSDT kline 2024-01-02; BTCUSDT fundingRate Jan 2024; ETHUSDT fundingRate Jan 2024; supplemental btc/ btc_funding/ subdirs under research_state/data/raw/ (incomplete coverage for full window).
sample_minima_note: Local domain does NOT meet the >=5 symbols / >=1 complete month / >=3 non-overlapping 30-day blocks minima; results where minima not met are reported as NOT_SUPPORTED or INCONCLUSIVE, never fabricated as GO.

hypotheses.statement: In the local hourly kline + funding panel, elevated funding rate (absolute value) is associated with elevated subsequent realized volatility (1h absolute log-return), consistent with funding-conditioned volatility.
hypotheses.direction: positive association between |funding rate| and subsequent |log return|
hypotheses.test: Spearman rank correlation between |funding_t| and |logreturn_{t+1}| within each symbol-block; per-block p < 0.05 required; combined via Fisher across admissible blocks.

hypotheses.statement: Hours with funding rate of opposite sign to prior return (mean-reversion pressure) show reduced subsequent volatility vs same-sign funding hours.
hypotheses.test: Compare mean subsequent |log return| for opposite-sign vs same-sign funding hours within each admissible block; two-sample t-test per block, p < 0.05.

hypotheses.statement: No proxy for liquidation risk is computable from the local domain (no liquidation labels); any liquidation-conditioned claim is NOT_SUPPORTED by design.
hypotheses.test: Absence check: no liquidationSnapshot/liquidation column present in any local CSV.

analysis_plan.block_definition: Non-overlapping 30-day blocks aligned to calendar month boundaries where data permits; blocks must each contain >=5 symbols OR be single-symbol but with full-month coverage. Local domain has 2 symbols and incomplete monthly coverage, so blocks may fail minima.
analysis_plan.block_minima: Each block requires >=5 symbols OR >=1 complete month with documented completeness. Local domain: 2 symbols, partial hourly coverage -> blocks likely INCONCLUSIVE/NOT_SUPPORTED.

features.log_return_t: log(close_t / close_{t-1}) per symbol per hour
features.funding_t: funding rate at hour t (nearest prior funding timestamp <= t)

decision_rules.GO: >=1 admissible block passes H1 at alpha 0.05 AND H2 direction consistent AND H3 absence confirmed
decision_rules.NOT_SUPPORTED: no admissible block meets minima OR liquidation labels absent (H3) AND no external source available
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: admissible blocks exist but sample too small for powered test

analysis_plan.null_handling: NOT_SUPPORTED and INCONCLUSIVE are preserved as legitimate outcomes; never coerced to GO.

recompute_independence: Independent recompute script (fclr_next_source_verify01_recompute_20261122T033000Z.py) recomputes all statistics from raw CSVs using a separate code path; results compared for numerical agreement.
